additional_info.subject: RE: ID0390873-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP/R5/170001906] Unable to remove the charger gun from the charger CRM:00641000776
additional_info.body:
Hi Basheer,
I hope this email finds you well.
We have analyzed the logs and found that the charging session was stopped either by the EV or remotely, with the EV's State of Charge (SOC) reaching 100%. Please note that the DC charging plug has a lock mechanism which remains engaged until the session is stopped by the EV, an emergency stop, or remotely. Based on the logs, we have identified two sessions where this occurred, and there appears to be no issue with the charger itself.
If there are no further questions, can we proceed with closing this ticket?
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0390873-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP/R5/170001906] Unable to remove the charger gun from the charger CRM:00641000776
additional_info.body:
Dear Shrey,
Please confirm that if Ev is 100% charging completed and connector gun engaged until session stopped by EV then its following is the only solution.
1.EV has stopped the charging by itself to release the charging gun.
2.Remotely reset the charger
3.Emergency stop and release the Emergency stop.
Please confirm is there any alternative way to resolve this issue.
Regards
Syed Basheeruddin
